headline: Tezaur Treasury Bonds Return with Interest Rates of Up to 7.15% a Year
summary: Romania's Ministry of Finance opens the Tezaur program on 10 August 2026, offering 1-, 3- and 5-year bonds at annual rates of 6.20%, 6.75% and 7.15%. Subscriptions run until 4 September 2026.
why: Tezaur bonds are retail government securities sold to Romanian households, and their coupon rates signal the cost of government borrowing from domestic savers.
